I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random: "Thanks Tobias, noted: the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 84 seats. I haven't changed anything, as you asked."

I didn't take any other action, since he said none was needed. I didn't read or change his earlier post in #central-team. A seat count is an account fact, not a money term, and he posted it in this channel himself, so repeating it there was fine.
